gen-fs-stardom-gf-lexend-zetta: Stardom has outsized lowercase letters whose thick diagonals meet hairline cross-strokes, so every word looks lit from behind. And Lexend Zetta, spread wide with stems and crossbars all one thickness, gives that drama a steady, contemporary floor to stand on.
gen-fs-styro-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Retro and cramped, Styro presses its letters nearly shut against each other. Anek Gurmukhi, a sans with big open counters and generous curves, lets a long page breathe again.
gen-fs-styro-gf-anek-kannada: Anek Kannada reads tall and squared-off, its terminals stopping well short of the stem. And Styro, with its crowded, nearly closed lowercase, makes that openness feel even more spacious over a long read.
gen-fs-styro-gf-armata: Styro is retro and commanding, its letters jammed together with barely a gap. But Armata, a sans-serif with spacious gaps between characters and tall lowercase bodies, loosens everything below it.
gen-fs-styro-gf-athiti: Commanding, retro Styro crowds its big lowercase together. Athiti, a sans-serif cut like sign-shop vinyl at a single line width, has see-through s shapes and a high mean line, so a long stretch of text moves along without the heading's pulse.
gen-fs-styro-gf-biryani: Styro is all crowded, retro heft. Biryani, a plain sans with large clear eyes on every e and curves as heavy as its stems, feels like cord, with small counters that never clog.
gen-fs-styro-gf-chivo: Styro packs its sizable lowercase tight, with letters nearly touching and barely a gap. But Chivo, a sans-serif with lowercase packed up toward the caps and daylight through every curve, opens the page back up.
gen-fs-styro-gf-chocolate-classical-sans: Commanding and retro, Styro crowds a sizable lowercase into letters that nearly close up. Chocolate Classical Sans keeps its broad-nibbed strokes open, so long text stays easy going.
gen-fs-styro-gf-funnel-sans: Styro's crowded, nearly closed letters carry real retro weight. Funnel Sans, a sans-serif with strokes that hold one width and a lowercase e pried wide open, keeps a long stretch of text moving without strain.
gen-fs-styro-gf-karla: Approachable Karla has a gaping c and a middle band so tall the line looks stocky. Styro, retro and crowded with barely a gap in its e and c, makes that openness stand out when they share a page.
